name: PSZ2 G091.79-27.00 (Webb)
blurb: PSZ2 G091.79-27.00, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Webb.
label: psz2g091-webb
story: A rich cluster of galaxies gathered around its brightest members, one of 182 massive clusters Webb is surveying to learn how infalling galaxies build up a cluster's stars and how dark matter is spread through it.

claims.text: PSZ2G091.79-27.00 is a target of JWST program 5594 (SLICE), described as brightest cluster galaxies, rich cluster
The program images 182 massive galaxy clusters to study how infalling galaxies build cluster stellar content and how dark matter is distributed
Also known as RXC J2245.4+2808 and PSZ1 G091.81-26.97
